oral_examination.oral_examination: *36*37 The gums are moderately and severely receded, loosening to degree III, and percussion (-). Nothing special. CBCT shows that *36*37 alveolar bone has been absorbed to the apical 1/3

treatment_plan.notes: Do not chew on the affected side for 2 hours! Follow up for discomfort! Do not bite hard objects.

source_handle: *36*37 Local povidone-iodine disinfection, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride/local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol anesthesia. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
